exposure: Ambulatory blood pressure (ABP) measures (24-h SBP, awake/sleep SBP, diastolic BP, circadian rhythm)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 146 pregnant women who were seen for maternal medical checkups or suspected hypertension.
finding: Ambulatory blood pressure (ABP) monitoring measures performed during pregnancy were more closely associated with small-for-gestational-age (SGA) birth weight than clinic blood pressure.
